name: Judgment Of Christ
overview: The Judgment of Christ is a solemn reality where all individuals will stand before His judgment seat, as affirmed in Romans 14:10. Scripture reveals that after physical death, each person faces this appointed judgment (Hebrews 9:27). Yet, the foundation of hope lies in God's love demonstrated through the giving of His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him will receive everlasting life (John 3:16). This truth calls believers to live in reverent awareness of Christ's authority as Judge and Savior.
